engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row167 Wistron-System RAS-00124-V002: approve GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, DIMM POR or non-POR exception, CScripts/ITP versions/hashes/licenses and CE-recipe dependency; prove address0x100000000 maps to primary socket0/MC0/ch0 and secondary MC1, approve deferred Inj2ndCh roles and cafecafe write/wbinvd/read, exact primary B2CMI and secondary IMC/retry-log fields, plus OOB no-retry recovery/restoration.

review_improvement: Converts generic log collection into a traceable two-injector state machine with controller-local acceptance and prevents a host-level correction from being mistaken for proof of both mirrored-copy faults.
independent_technical_reasoning: The experiment depends on ordering and locality: both injectors must be armed before writeback, writeback must place each fault into its mapped copy, and the later read must first encounter the primary UCE then recover data from the secondary CE. Primary MSCOD1 plus mirror misc bits proves mirror recovery; secondary MSCOD0x80 and retry logs prove correction of the buddy copy. Without the armed/unarmed transitions or address equality, those records could be unrelated. A repeat would add ambiguous errors.
